download_blender_9B_model: download the Blender 9.4B parameter model to a specified datapath using the download function
run_download_for_blender_9B: run the download function to fetch the BST9B.tgz model archive into the data directory
build_blender_9B_model: build and download the Blender 9B model by calling build with model_type blender_9B
review_download_function: review the download function that wraps build to fetch the Blender 9.4B model
summarize_blender_9B_module: summarize the blender_9B module which provides a download function for the 9.4B parameter Blender model
